facts.fact: Under DFPD's instructions to States, the fair price shop dealer must ensure that no genuine beneficiary is denied foodgrains because biometric (fingerprint) authentication fails
facts.quote: shall ensure that no genuine beneficiary is denied foodgrains due to failure of biometric authentication.

facts.fact: Beneficiaries whose biometric e-KYC is denied after repeated attempts are flagged for physical verification
facts.quote: Beneficiaries whose eKYC is denied due to biometric authentication failure, after repeated attempts, will be also flagged for physical verification.

facts.fact: Iris-based authentication, besides fingerprint, may be provided on the e-PoS to improve the success rate
facts.quote: Note: Finger as well as IRIS based e-KYC facility may be provided to ensure better success rate

behaviour: States only the provisions in official NFSA/DFPD instructions (no denial for genuine beneficiaries when fingerprint authentication fails; iris option; physical verification), with a citation, and directs the user to the State food department/helpline for the State's exception or nominee procedure; if a provision (e.g. a nominee facility) is not found in an official source, says so rather than inventing it.
fail_if: It invents a central nominee or proxy procedure; says the beneficiary will lose ration if fingerprints fail; gives a made-up helpline; cites unofficial sites.
summary: Added from DFPD's e-KYC advisory compilation (25.06.2024): no genuine beneficiary to be denied grain for biometric failure; repeated failures go to physical verification; iris option. No central nominee provision found.
